description: Bundled WeiDU build with mod-runner modifications. Current revision treats BCS decompile/recompile round-trip failures as non-fatal inside DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH blocks. Instead of aborting the install when a script can't survive a round-trip (often caused by IDS-state changes in large mod stacks like Ajantis NPC, Golem Construction, SoD companions), WeiDU logs a warning and returns the original buffer unchanged.
what_it_changes: Adds a decompile_and_patch_context flag to track DECOMPILE_AND_PATCH scope.

Silencing a round-trip failure means the mod's intended patch is skipped for that script; the mod may later detect missing changes and behave unexpectedly.
